# State of AI- November 2026, Thu, Nov 5, 2026, 12:30 PM   | Meetup

Discover how AI is reshaping the way organizations build, deploy, and scale intelligent systems.

​We’re bringing together AI practitioners, product leaders, engineers, and innovators to explore real-world applications, emerging trends, and the evolving standards shaping the future of artificial intelligence. Join us for thoughtful discussions on what’s working today, what’s coming next, and how teams can build smarter, more responsible AI solutions.
